_comment: Curated, human-verified entry policies. Any (country_code, nationality) listed here is AUTHORITATIVE: it wins over the LLM cache AND any row already in the entry_policy table, and is never re-queried. This is the correction path -- if the site ever shows a wrong visa reading, add or fix the pair here and redeploy. Keys prefixed with _ are commentary and ignored. Fields mirror the assess_entry_policy tool; omitted booleans default to false, an omitted permitted_days/entry_card_name to null.
_permit_types: visa_free | evisa | visa_on_arrival | visa | residency | citizen

policies._note: Mexican citizens need a Visa on Arrival (e-VOA / VoA) for Indonesia, 30 days, plus the electronic customs declaration (e-CD) on arrival. They are NOT visa-free. This entry corrects an LLM reading that wrongly said visa_free (2026-08-05).
policies.advisory: Advisory only -- border rules change without notice, verify with the Indonesian mission before you fly.
policies.source: Manually verified. Corrects a claude-sonnet-5 error that read visa-free.

policies._note: US citizens: Visa on Arrival for Indonesia, 30 days, e-CD on arrival. Pinned here so the whole Indonesia corridor is authoritative, not just the corrected MX pair.
